_comment: Prompt eval set for the group-chat FAQ bot. Run against the real model via `pnpm eval:faq` with `pnpm dev` running in the worker directory. These are NOT unit tests — they call Workers AI and cost (a trivial amount of) money. Messages are deliberately worded differently from the phrasings in parameters/faqs.json: matching the canonical wording proves nothing, matching a paraphrase is the actual job. Expected values encode judgement calls; when the model disagrees, decide whether the prompt is wrong or the expectation is.

cases.name: volunteer hours — paraphrased, not the canonical wording
cases.message: my hours still aren't showing up on giving.sg, anyone know why?

cases.name: volunteer hours — asked without a question mark
cases.message: finished the programme ages ago but still no hours credited

cases.name: reports — paraphrased, mentions the wrong bot
cases.message: I keep sending scam texts to the telegram bot but my report count never goes up

cases.name: reports — how do I even report
cases.message: whats the right way to send in a scam message I got?

cases.name: timesheet — paraphrased, gives a reason rather than naming the doc
cases.message: school needs proof of my volunteering, who do I ask for that?

cases.name: not receiving messages to vote on
cases.message: haven't been sent anything to vote on for about a week now, is that normal?

cases.name: votes missing from leaderboard
cases.message: voted on a bunch yesterday but the leaderboard hasn't moved at all

cases.name: timesheet and hours are different entries — should not be confused
cases.message: who do I ping to get a timesheet?

cases.name: not covered — accuracy scoring is no longer an FAQ
cases.message: how exactly is my accuracy score worked out?

cases.name: not covered — expenses
cases.message: can I claim transport reimbursement for the volunteer meetup next month?

cases.name: not covered — adjacent to reports but a different question
cases.message: who decides whether something counts as a scam or just spam?

cases.name: statement, not a question
cases.message: just finished my 50th vote today, feeling good about it

cases.name: greeting is not a question
cases.message: morning everyone, hope you all had a good weekend

cases.message: when do the volunteer hours actually show up on giving.sg?
